title: Reviewer report
description: One reviewer's output for one round. Both the Codex leg and the Claude leg produce this shape, so the merger reads a single format.

status.description: Whether the review ran. An empty findings list means the diff is clean only under 'ok'; under 'failed' or 'no_input' it means the reviewer never looked.

reviewer.description: Which leg produced this report: codex, claude, or a fan-out dimension name.

round.description: Review round this report belongs to. The orchestrator rejects a report whose round does not match the round it asked for.

target.description: What the reviewer actually looked at. The orchestrator compares these against the round's recorded target to detect a working tree that moved mid-review.

head_oid.description: git rev-parse HEAD, read at the start of the review.

snapshot_oid.description: The round's snapshot commit, copied from target.json.

dirty_digest_start.description: Digest of the working tree state read before the first file is opened.

dirty_digest_end.description: The same digest re-read after the last file. A value differing from dirty_digest_start means the tree moved and the findings are stale.

verdict.description: approve when nothing blocks, revise when something does, inconclusive when the reviewer could not reach a position.

findings.description: Defects the diff introduces. Problems the diff did not cause belong in preexisting.

local_id.description: Identifier unique within this file, such as claude-r2-3. The merger assigns the run-stable id.

prior_id.description: Ledger id this finding restates, when the reviewer recognizes it as one it already filed.

severity.description: blocker breaks correctness or safety, major is a defect worth fixing before merge, minor is a preference.

confidence.description: How sure the reviewer is that the defect is real, not how bad it would be.

title.description: One line naming the defect, with no severity prefix.

why.description: The concrete failure: the input, state, or sequence that produces it.

evidence.description: Paths, line numbers, and quoted code that let someone else re-derive the finding without trusting the reviewer.

depends_on_premise.description: The assumption the finding rests on. Refute the premise and the finding is gone. The merger compares these across legs to spot contradictions.

suggestion.description: What to change. Name the mechanism, not just the goal.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root. An absolute path is a bug in the adapter that produced this file.

symbol.description: Enclosing declaration as Class#method or a bare function name. It survives the line shifts that later rounds introduce, which is why the ledger matches on it.

introduced_by_diff.description: True when the reviewed diff causes the defect. False when the diff only exposes it.

preexisting.description: Problems outside the change. They are reported once and never block convergence.

checked_without_findings.description: What the reviewer examined and found sound. This is what distinguishes a thorough clean review from a shallow one.
